display.purpose: Hero <h1> only. The brand's loudest statement. Single use per page.

headline.purpose: Section <h2> headings. One per section. Sets the section subject.

title.purpose: Card headings, product names, component titles. Also used at 42px for product size labels as a deliberate typographic moment.

body.purpose: Section paragraphs and card descriptions. Max 65–75ch line length. line-height 1.75 required on dark backgrounds.

label.purpose: Section tags, nav links, metadata, status badges. Always DM Sans. Always uppercase with 0.12em tracking.

shadows.name: card-hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Hover state for glass cards. Activates on cursor enter; not present at rest.

shadows.name: bottle-card-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover state for product/bottle cards. Compound: hard depth shadow plus soft teal glow.

shadows.name: button-primary-rest
shadows.purpose: Ambient glow on primary buttons at rest. Signals interactivity without hover.

shadows.name: button-primary-hover
shadows.purpose: Intensified glow on primary button hover.

shadows.name: bottle-drop-shadow
shadows.purpose: SVG filter on bottle illustrations. Teal glow beneath the product. Signature brand moment — do not replicate on other elements.

shadows.name: bottle-hover-drop-shadow
shadows.purpose: Intensified bottle drop-shadow on product card hover.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover lift (translateY), scale, and button transitions. Exponential ease-out: responsive onset, graceful stop.

motion.name: ease-bottle
motion.purpose: Bottle card hover and SVG scale transitions. Slightly softer than ease-standard; matches the physical weight of the bottle.

motion.name: float-a
motion.purpose: Hero bottle float animation. Offset: -6deg rotation, 22px vertical range.

motion.name: float-b
motion.purpose: Hero bottle float animation. Offset: 4deg rotation, 22px vertical range. Different phase from floatA.

motion.name: float-c
motion.purpose: Hero bottle float animation. Offset: -2deg rotation, 22px vertical range.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Hero, about, contact, footer grids collapse to 1 column. Nav links hidden. Hero bottle trio hides; single bottle shows.

breakpoints.name: content-max
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width for section inner content containers.

narrative.overview:
AquaVia occupies the altitude where mountain-sourced purity meets corporate precision. The design system is built on a field of near-black navy — not because dark is fashionable, but because a procurement manager evaluating this product at a hotel front desk or a conference room side table is surrounded by artificial light, white tablecloths, and ambient clutter. The dark field cuts through. The teal accent reads like water light on stone. The gold says: this bottle has been placed on a 5-star table before.

This is not a wellness brand. It is not a SaaS product. It is not a consumer FMCG. It is an Indian B2B premium goods brand that happens to sell water — and the design should behave accordingly: confident, legible from a distance, warm enough to close a deal, cold enough to be believed.

The system rejects the catalog aesthetics of Indiamart, the startup-blue minimalism of SaaS landing pages, and the loud discount-banner energy of consumer retail. Every surface should read: "We have placed bottles in boardrooms. We will place them in yours."
keyCharacteristics: Full-palette dark field with three tonal navy layers (abyssal, mid, card)
Teal accent reserved for interaction and active state only — its scarcity is structural
Durbar Gold as a premium signal: used twice per screen maximum
Editorial serif (Cormorant Garamond) for structural elements; precision sans (DM Sans) for operational text
Glass layer for floating UI; flat tonal steps for everything else
Hover state as primary depth cue: lift, glow, and border brightening
Scroll-reveal choreography on section entry; floating animation on hero bottles

rules.name: The Cold Light Rule
rules.body: Glacial Melt is never a background fill for large surfaces. It exists on borders, button fills, focus rings, and glow sources. If a surface is predominantly teal, something has gone wrong.

rules.name: The Gold Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Durbar Gold appears in at most two distinct locations per screen. The badge, the bar, or the accent — never all three simultaneously.

rules.name: The Depth Stack Rule
rules.body: New surfaces can only step up the tonal stack (abyssal → mid → card → glass), never sideways to an unrelated color.

rules.name: The Separation of Voices Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond is structural: headings, size labels, product names, large numerics. DM Sans is operational: body text, buttons, nav, labels, form controls. They do not swap roles.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond is never used below 18px in any context. Below that size, the stroke contrast collapses on dark backgrounds.

rules.name: The Stat Rule
rules.body: Hero metric numbers (500+, 2Cr+, 48hr) are always Cormorant Garamond 700 at 32px or larger with Glacial Melt as the color. The supporting label is DM Sans 13px Arctic Haze. This is the one place where a number-plus-label structure is permitted.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The three navy tonal steps provide all the depth the system needs at rest. Shadows appear only as hover state feedback, never baked into a component's default appearance.

rules.name: The Glow Source Rule
rules.body: All glows use Glacial Melt (rgba(62,207,191,...)) as the light source. No purple glow, no white glow, no gold glow. The teal glow is the system's signature.

dos: Do use the three-step navy tonal stack (abyssal → mid → card) for all surface layering.
Do reserve Glacial Melt exclusively for interactive elements: CTA buttons, focus rings, active borders, hover glows, and the scroll indicator.
Do use Cormorant Garamond for headings, size labels, and large numerics at 18px or above.
Do apply hover lift (translateY) with cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) easing.
Do limit Durbar Gold to two placements per screen.
Do cap all body text at 65–75ch line length and set line-height: 1.75 on dark backgrounds.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable float animations, shimmer sweeps, and entrance choreography.
Do provide outline: 2px solid #3ecfbf; outline-offset: 3px as the focus ring on all interactive elements.
Do use glass cards only for content that floats above a section background.
donts: Don't use the Indiamart catalog aesthetic: cluttered text-heavy layouts, table-bordered pricing grids, overcrowded feature lists.
Don't import generic SaaS blue into the palette (Intercom blue, Notion grey-blue, Linear purple-blue).
Don't use loud consumer retail signals: discount-banner yellow, bright red SALE tags, flashing urgency elements.
Don't introduce health-food or wellness-brand greens (sage, olive, earthy forest green).
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with a background-image gradient) on new elements.
Don't apply glass cards by default to every surface — reserve backdrop-filter blur for purposeful elevation moments.
Don't add side-stripe borders (border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent) to cards, list items, or callouts.
Don't add a third typeface to the system.
Don't stack multiple Most Popular badges or gold premium signals in a single viewport.
Don't animate CSS layout properties (width, height, padding, margin) — animate transform and opacity only.
